day_line: A jewel on a Pig day. Polished and generous: good for kind gestures and tidy finishes, easy to overspend.

lines.Yang Wood: Your hard work shines today. Send the summary; let the numbers speak.
lines.Yin Wood: Thursday tightens the screws a bit. Clear the urgent one, then step outside.
lines.Yang Fire: Small savings feel good today. Cancel the subscription you forgot about.
lines.Yin Fire: An unexpected offer turns up today. Hear it out before you say no.
lines.Yang Earth: Your ideas flow today. Write the proposal while you still feel it.
lines.Yin Earth: Thursday feels generous to you. Treat yourself to a proper sit-down lunch.
lines.Yang Metal: Someone's chasing the same goal today. Compare notes; you'll both get there faster.
lines.Yin Metal: Your best people are close today. Pick the Christmas dinner date in the chat now.
lines.Yang Water: An older hand guides you today. Ask for their view; it saves a wrong turn.
lines.Yin Water: Your instinct is sharp today. Note the first idea; it's usually the right one.
